mapper.sql: a.id, a.user_id, a.agent_name, a.agent_code, a.agent_level, a.parent_id, a.contact, a.address, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, pa.agent_name as parent_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agents a LEFT JOIN agents pa ON a.parent_id = pa.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM agents a LEFT JOIN agents pa ON a.parent_id = pa.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM agents a LEFT JOIN agents pa ON a.parent_id = pa.id WHERE a.parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT FROM agents a LEFT JOIN agents pa ON a.parent_id = pa.id WHERE a.agent_level = #{level}
SELECT FROM agents a LEFT JOIN agents pa ON a.parent_id = pa.id ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT FROM agents a LEFT JOIN agents pa ON a.parent_id = pa.id WHERE 1=1
AND a.agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentName}, '%')
AND a.agent_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentCode}, '%')
AND a.status = #{status}
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agents (user_id, agent_name, agent_code, agent_level, parent_id, contact, address, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{agentName}, #{agentCode}, #{agentLevel}, #{parentId}, #{contact}, #{address}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE agents SET user_id = #{userId}, agent_name = #{agentName}, agent_code = #{agentCode}, agent_level = #{agentLevel}, parent_id = #{parentId}, contact = #{contact}, address = #{address}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
